in_sanskrit.name: Anji
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Graceful, Radiant
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Anji एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Anji is a Sanskrit name derived from the word ‘anjan’ which means ‘graceful, radiant, and beautiful’. It is also associated with the goddess Anjani, the mother of Lord Hanuman in Hindu mythology.
